name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu
short_description: A half marathon series event in Mandaue, Cebu on August 2, 2026, featuring 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu is set for August 2, 2026, at Ayala Malls Gatewalk in Mandaue, Cebu, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series brand, the event offers three distance options: a 21.1-kilometer half marathon as the primary race, plus 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer distances. Registration details have not yet been announced, so interested runners should watch for updates as the date approaches.
